what_it_measured.text: The present study aims to explore the skin protective effects of a novel extract of ferment in combination with copper tripeptide-1 GHK-Cu from an anti-inflammation perspective.
A clinical trial was conducted by a third-party research organization to evaluate the anti-aging effects of the cream containing 5% TBFE and 0.2% GHK-Cu on human subjects.
